title: New York closes orange before Gamma exits Jail
description: New York closes orange before Gamma exits Jail. New York is a source-backed high-traffic orange; buying denies an auction to two liquid opponents. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: I own 2 of 3 orange properties; buying NY Avenue for $200 completes the set, enabling houses and high rent. I have enough cash (520) to afford it and still have liquidity. Starting an auction risks losing the property or overpaying. So I will buy.

breakdown.message: Chooses buy_property for this exact purchase/auction context.
Stays on the purchase branch when the price is strategically justified.
Leaves at least $250 after the action.
